answer_1.quote: The task of generating natural language text from knowledge graphs has been extensively studied... We investigate how a KG-to-English text model fine-tuned on silver data can be optimised using preference learning.
answer_1.outputs: Generated natural language descriptions of knowledge graphs

answer_2.quote: We use 8 referencebased metrics such as SacreBLEU (Post, 2018), TER, METEOR (Banerjee and Lavie, 2005), ChrF++ (Popović, 2017), BERTScore, BLEURT, SEScore2. We also evaluate factual alignment with the input graph using reference-less metrics like EREDAT (Scao and Gardent, 2023), FactSpotter.
